enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Shift arm. Remain asleep. Snore lightly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, showering, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Walk to shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea, listening to the news about the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Place bread on counter. Pick up toaster. Plug in toaster. Insert bread slices. Press lever. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out cup. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in cup. Toast pops up. Remove toast. Place on plate. Spread butter. Pour hot water into cup. Stir tea. Add milk. Sit down. Eat toast. Drink tea. Turn on radio. Listen to news about transport strike. Finish eating. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Turn on tap. Wash plate. Wash cup. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Turn off radio. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Settling at the desk, turning on the desk lamp, and checking work messages to confirm remote work arrangements for the strike day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Walk to desk. Pull out chair. Sit down. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Put down phone. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for computer to start. Open email. Check emails. Read email about remote work. Close email. Open messaging app. Reply to message. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer, coordinating community program schedules, answering emails, and joining online calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open document. Type program schedule. Make phone call. Speak: 'Hello, this is Member 1.' Listen. Take notes. End call. Join video call. Speak: 'Good morning, everyone.' Share screen. Discuss program plans. Mute microphone. Unmute. Type notes. End call. Check messages. Reply to messages. Open spreadsheet. Update data. Save file. Open document. Draft schedule. Save file. Close document.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a simple lunch and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add salt. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Turn on tap. Wash plate. Wash utensils. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, watching TV, and stretching
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Bend forward. Sit down. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work on the computer, drafting program plans, and following up with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Draft program plan. Type. Save. Open video call. Speak: 'Let's discuss the timeline.' Listen. Take notes. End call. Make phone call. Speak: 'Hello, I'm following up on our partnership.' Listen. End call. Open spreadsheet. Update. Save. Check messages. Reply. Open document. Draft plan. Type. Save. Close document.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and having an afternoon tea break with a light snack
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Place on base. Turn on kettle. Open cupboard. Take out cup. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in cup. Take out snack. Place snack on plate. Kettle boils. Pour water into cup. Stir tea. Add milk. Sit down. Eat snack. Drink tea. Finish. Stand up. Carry cup to sink. Turn on tap. Wash cup. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room and tidying up the common area
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move table. Vacuum under table. Turn off vacuum. Unplug. Put away vacuum. Pick up items on floor. Place in box. Wipe table with cloth. Arrange cushions. Pick up trash. Throw in bin. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Carry to table. Sit down. Eat. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Turn on tap. Wash plate. Wash utensils. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with TV and a game console, with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Play game. Pause game. Watch TV. Change channel. Play game. Speak: 'Yes!' Pause game. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Turn off game console. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone in bed with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on fan. Lie on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open app. Scroll. Read. Type. Send message. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Scroll. Read. Put down phone. Turn off fan.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Shift arm. Remain asleep. Snore lightly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.
